question.problem:
$n$ is less than $10$ **or** $13$, **and** $n$ is an integer

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $X(n):$ $n$ is less than $10$

- $Y(n):$ $n$ is less than $13$

- $Z(n):$ $n$ is an integer
question.worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧,$" while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨.$"

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:  

- **Part 1:** $n$ is less than $10$ or $13.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{n\text{ is less than }10}_{⏟}}_{X}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{n\text{ is less than }13}_{⏟}}_{Y},
$$

that is, $X∨Y.$

- **Part 2:** $n$ is an integer. This corresponds to $Z.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{n\text{ is less than }10\text{ or }13}_{⏟}}_{X∨Y}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{n\text{ is an integer}}_{⏟}}_{Z},
$$

that is, $(X∨Y)∧Z.$
